_readme: FIAT ROOM CARD BOXES (18 Oct, Matt: option C, a strip of scene on each box). The other 24, after the Map's test.
Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_room_boxes_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; ++ --only <name> ++ --force to reroll)

jobs.description: Pixel art, a wide close view: a padded work jacket and a hard hat hung on hooks on a breeze-block wall, boots on the floor below. Muted blue-grey palette, dark navy shadows, overcast evening light, one or two warm orange lamps. A wide, low strip: the subject sits across the middle, filling the width, with nothing important in the top or bottom eighth (the strip is cropped to fit its box). Only the palette, light and painting style of the style image, not its view or its subject. One continuous scene edge to edge, no border, no frame. No people unless the brief names them, no text, no readable signage, numbers or lettering.
